name: Takeover primitives spread across DIFFERENT roles -> NO critical takeover
note: IAM-902 negative: the grant + trust-modify legs target role/RoleA while the sts:AssumeRole targets a DIFFERENT role/RoleB. The takeover requires all three primitives on the SAME role, so no compound ROLE-TAKEOVER may be asserted; the individual primitives still surface on their own statements.
